name: [❄️] +1 Speed Survival!
desc:
⚡ Welcome to +1 Speed Survival! ⚡

💤 EARN SPEED AS YOU PLAY! ⚡

How to Play:
👟 Gain speed with every step you take
🏃 Run through intense obstacle courses
💪 Train on treadmills or sprint across the map
🏆 Reach checkpoints, beat levels, and escape!
❤️‍🔥 Rebirth to reset and come back even stronger

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players

⚠️ Like & favorite the game for rewards, and join the group for updates, bonuses, and exclusive news!
